disclosures.statement: The frozen-geometry observation of section A is a PRECHECK: it gates which candidates are censused (none, under the pinned dynamics) but never by itself names the verdict.  The verdict-naming facts -- the census counts, the choice inventory, the selector fibers and the trajectory types -- are measured on the CENSUSED objects (RUNBOOK section 13 addendum, v13 #314).

Three clauses are analytically forced once the design space is uniform in the link index: chart equivariance of every censused candidate, the pointwise fixedness of the uniform space under the chart action, and the vanishing of the s-defect for front-blind movers.  All three are RECORDED as disclosures and the gates that carry them are paired with the per-link positive control, which is not forced and does move.

The coefficient box {-1,0,1,2} and the two atom families are DECLARED arena data.  Every count in the census is relative to them.  The box-independent statements are: the forced set is the identity alone; the stabilizer selects nothing; and the strongest declared selector leaves a fiber of at least two movers that are separated by a pinned-visible readout.

Convergence is typed on the declared horizon t <= 20.  Limits are exact and are certified by exact reproduction of every window value under the POLY / EXPC classification; no limit is claimed for a sequence the classifier does not certify.

SEL-CLOSURE, SEL-COMMUTE-AXIS, SEL-COMMUTE-INSERT and SEL-JOINT are DECLARED BY THIS UNIT.  No pinned source requires a geometry move to preserve closure or to commute with H_a[N] -- the pinned source freezes s instead, so the question never arises there.  Their fibers are reported as what a successor would inherit if it adopted them, never as pinned forcings.

The v14 LOG #4 erratum records that two R0 companion hashes were stale by one commit.  This unit's three pinned sources are anchored by their own sha256-12 at run time and all three verify; no value here reads from a companion hash.

gates.name: G-MUTANT-BLINDNESS
gates.statement: no gate-registering function reads run-mode identity (MUTANT / DELIVERY_RUN / argv); the scanner is validated by four synthetic injections it must flag

gates.name: G-ANCHOR-COUNT
gates.statement: every declared source-hash row is evaluated

gates.name: G-CLAUSES-VERBATIM
gates.statement: every pinned clause this unit reasons from is quoted VERBATIM from the pinned source on disk

gates.name: G-CLAUSE-TABLE-COMPLETE
gates.statement: the clause table carries every declared clause

gates.name: G-ENGRAVINGS-PRESENT
gates.statement: the engraved rules this unit's compliance gates cite are quoted VERBATIM from RUNBOOK.md on disk

gates.name: G-S-FROZEN-POINTWISE
gates.statement: over every (rule, record, lapse, register) instance the geometry sector s is bit-identical after H_a[N] and after H_a[N]^{-1}, and the (n, m) sectors invert exactly

gates.name: G-S-ORBIT-SINGLETON
gates.statement: the s-image of the pinned move monoid (H_a[N], its inverse, D_a[v]) is a SINGLE point at depth 4 -- the pinned layer has no geometry-record motion at all

gates.name: G-S-ORBIT-INSTRUMENT-SEES-MOTION
gates.statement: POSITIVE CONTROL: the same orbit instrument, given one extra geometry-writing generator, returns an orbit of size depth+1 -- so the singleton above is a measurement, not a property of the instrument

gates.name: G-ATOM-EXPRESSIBILITY
gates.statement: every atom in the design space is licensed by a quoted pinned clause, and the declared NEGATIVE CONTROL atom (a held-out chart label) is excluded

gates.name: G-CENSUS-TWO-ROUTES-LIN
gates.statement: the LIN census counts are reproduced by an INDEPENDENT recomputation that builds its admissibility predicate from the record readout rather than from the determinant expression (RUNBOOK section 14 addendum, v13 #219)

gates.name: G-CENSUS-CELLS-COMPLETE-LIN
gates.statement: the LIN probe-cell set equals an INDEPENDENT enumeration of the complete (record, lapse, front, site) product, and that product has the declared size -- a silently dropped cell cannot shrink the census

gates.name: G-CENSUS-TWO-ROUTES-BIL
gates.statement: the BIL census counts are reproduced by an INDEPENDENT recomputation that builds its admissibility predicate from the record readout rather than from the determinant expression (RUNBOOK section 14 addendum, v13 #219)

gates.name: G-CENSUS-CELLS-COMPLETE-BIL
gates.statement: the BIL probe-cell set equals an INDEPENDENT enumeration of the complete (record, lapse, front, site) product, and that product has the declared size -- a silently dropped cell cannot shrink the census

gates.name: G-FORCED-SET-COMPUTED
gates.statement: the class-(i) forced set is COMPUTED from the quoted pinned clause table, not typed: the only clause that speaks to s-evolution is C-FROZEN, and it forces the identity

gates.name: G-FORCED-ADVANCING-EMPTY
gates.statement: no pinned clause forces an ADVANCING geometry move: the forced set meets the admissible advancing set in the empty set

gates.name: G-CHART-ACTION-NONTRIVIAL
gates.statement: POSITIVE CONTROL for the stabilizer instrument: on the declared per-link coefficient space the chart group acts with orbits of size 2, so the instrument can detect a nontrivial action

gates.name: G-CLASS-II-SELECTS-NOTHING
gates.statement: the chart symmetry REDUCES the design space (per-link -> chart-equivariant) but SELECTS no mover: every candidate of the censused uniform space is a fixed point, so the stabilizer leaves the whole fiber standing

gates.name: G-CLASS-III-FIBER
gates.statement: every admissible advancing mover is class-(iii): no pinned clause forces it and no pinned symmetry selects it; the fiber is counted exactly

gates.name: G-SELECTOR-CENSUS-COMPLETE
gates.statement: every declared selector is censused

gates.name: G-NO-PINNED-SELECTOR-SELECTS
gates.statement: no PINNED selector cuts the fiber to one: the pinned clauses constrain the design space and never determine a member of it

gates.name: G-READ-LINK-CENSUS-COMPLETE
gates.statement: the commutation requirement depends on a drag rule only through its READ-LINK SET (the links whose interval count its weight consults). The count-reading rules realise exactly the read-link sets measured below, so the theorem's rule scope is a complete census over the distinct requirement classes and not an extrapolation from two samples

gates.name: G-STATIC-GEOMETRY-THEOREM
gates.statement: THE STATIC-GEOMETRY THEOREM: no admissible advancing mover commutes with H_a[N] for any count-reading drag rule -- the fiber is empty for the record-native closing rule A-axis and for the metric-inserted rule A-insert alike

gates.name: G-COUNT-BLIND-EXCEPTION
gates.statement: the two-sided reading: the exception is exactly the two count-blind rules, and each of them closes on exactly one record -- G-FLAT -- which every advancing move destroys

gates.name: G-COMMUTE-TWO-ROUTES
gates.statement: the commutation defect computed by LITERAL composition of the two maps on the triple state agrees with the independently built closed form at every tested cell

gates.name: G-TRAJ-CELLS-COMPLETE
gates.statement: the trajectory census is the complete (mover, schedule, record, normalization) product

gates.name: G-TRAJ-CLASSIFICATION-CERTIFIED
gates.statement: every sequence entering a limit is certified POLY or EXPC by exact reproduction of every window value, and the classification is STABLE under doubling the horizon: a spurious short-window fit would change its limit and does not

gates.name: G-UNCLASSIFIED-CHARACTERIZED
gates.statement: every cell the classifier declines is accounted for by a named mechanism -- a NON-STATIONARY schedule (the lapse profile changes with t, so the counts are quasi-polynomial rather than polynomial) or the lapse-modulated dilation, whose growth ratio 1+N(x) is site-dependent so the record is not a single geometric sequence.  There is no unexplained residue

gates.name: G-NORMALIZATION-RELATIVITY
gates.statement: MEASURED, not assumed: the convergence TYPE moves with the declared normalization at a nonzero number of cells -- 'the rescaled geometry converges' is a statement about the declared per-event denominator, and the count is reported

gates.name: G-LIMIT-MOVER-BLIND
gates.statement: the decisive trajectory finding, measured: at least one exact rescaled limit is shared by the FOREIGN fiat move and by two or more structurally different coupled movers -- convergence of the rescaled geometry does not discriminate the mover

gates.name: G-COUPLING-INSTRUMENT-SEPARATES
gates.statement: POSITIVE CONTROL, gated BEFORE the flag it licenses: the same instrument reports COUPLED for movers that read the lapse, the front and the record respectively, so the FOREIGN flag is a measurement and not a constant

gates.name: G-FOREIGN-FLAGGED
gates.statement: the declared external growth move (+1 into every interval count per step, by fiat) is flagged FOREIGN by the coupling instrument -- it reads no pinned field

gates.name: G-FOREIGN-AND-UNMOTIVATED-ARE-DIFFERENT-FINDINGS
gates.statement: the audit separates two gradings: FOREIGN (blind to every pinned field) and UNMOTIVATED (class-(iii) in the choice inventory).  The fiat move is both; every coupled mover is the second and not the first

gates.name: G-DISCRIMINATOR-CENSUS
gates.statement: the one-step record readout separates most but NOT all pairs of named movers: pairs that agree at one declared coordinate are counted rather than assumed away

gates.name: G-CACHE-EXERCISED
gates.statement: the weight memo is exercised AND what it returns is right: hits, misses and fresh bypasses are all nonzero and every fresh recomputation matches the memo (a zero-hit or zero-lookup cache gate is vacuous -- RUNBOOK section 14 addendum, v13 #219)

gates.name: G-VERDICT-STRING-EQUALITY
gates.statement: the COMPLETE emitted verdict string equals a string reconstructed segment by segment from the RECEIPT OBJECT by a function sharing no code and no input with the builder -- equality, never containment (RUNBOOK section 14 addendum, v14 #10)

prose: H_a[N] leaves the geometry record bit-identical at 2376 of 2376 (rule, record, lapse, register) instances, and the s-image of the whole pinned move monoid is a single point at depth 4, against 5 points when one geometry-writing generator is added.
Of 8192 declared candidate moves, 2976 are advancing and 1232 are admissible advancing movers.
The pinned clause table forces exactly 2 movers -- the identity, one per declared coefficient family -- and 0 advancing ones.

On the per-link coefficient space of 262144 points the chart group has 133120 orbits and 4096 fixed points; chart equivariance cuts that space to 4096, and the censused uniform space is fixed pointwise, so the stabilizer selects nothing.
The strongest declared selector, closure preservation, leaves a fiber of 4 movers; commuting advancing movers number 0 at 9 of 11 drag rules.
The commutation defect computed by literal composition and by the independent closed form agrees at 2916 of 2916 cells.
Across 972 trajectory cells at horizon t = 20, 531 converge, 117 diverge, 108 have an undefined normalization and 216 are unclassified, in 27 distinct exact limit classes.
The convergence type changes with the declared normalization at 216 of the 486 (mover, schedule, record) cells.
The exact rescaled limit (1/27, -1/54, 1/27) is reached by M-CLOSED, M-FIAT, M-FRONT, M-SOURCE, M-TARGET -- including the foreign fiat move.
The coupling instrument flags 1 of 1 declared external growth moves FOREIGN, and reports 7 coupled movers, every one of them class-(iii) unmotivated.
Of 36 pairs of named movers, 29 are separated by the one-step record readout at the declared coordinate.
